“We are pleased to have initiated the Phase 2b trial of LAM-001 for the treatment of pulmonary hypertension associated with interstitial lung disease (PH-ILD), and look forward to releasing top line bronchiolitis obliterans syndrome post lung transplant (BOS) data in the first quarter of next year.
Topline data is anticipated in the first quarter of 2028.

Based on compelling Phase 2a data presented at the American Thoracic Society (ATS) in May 2026, the company has advanced LAM-001 into a Phase 2b PH-ILD trial and data is anticipated in the first quarter of 2028.
The trial is fully enrolled, and data is anticipated in the first quarter of 2027.
